text: I'd like you to turn this pic of me into a professional headshot, with just a bit of tidying rather than a whole new look. I always feel a little nervous about edited portraits because I still want to recognise myself when I see the finished image. What matters most, somewhere in all of that, is that you keep my face recognisably me and don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. It's really just the lighting, outfit and background that I'd like you to tidy up. I'm hoping this will feel like a more polished version of the photo rather than make me feel like I'm looking at somebody else.
